from.place: Every point x∈X lies in an affine open chart, so O_{X,x} is a Noetherian local ring and has finite dimension by Krull's principal ideal theorem.

title: Finite local dimension for finite type schemes over a field
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-pc-scheme] of finite type over $K$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $x\in X$. Then the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ has finite Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

source.place: Lemma "lemma-dimension-at-a-point-finite-type-field" (Tag 00P1), together with the affine finite-type localization argument
